verdict.rationale: Sketch has its own named color variables: an AI feature generates 'a full set of named color variables' that are 'ready to use in your document'. Text styles appear only as something an AI client can recreate. Theming is limited to an AI feature that swaps light-mode components for dark-mode counterparts, which is component swapping rather than variable modes. missing for 10: spacing/number variables, documented variable modes or themes applied across designs, first-party docs on managing color variables and text styles directly, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can manage design tokens or variables — colors, spacing, typography — with modes or themes applied across designs

citations.quote: Drop in a photo and get a full set of named color variables that complement it. An instant color palette, ready to use in your document.
Point your AI client at a repo to recreate text styles, colors, UI components, and even entire pages inside Sketch.
Switch light mode components for their dark mode counterparts — all without making a single manual swap.
